description: This file defines a class 'AndroidBackHandler' that manages event listeners for Android back button presses in a web application context, with methods to add listeners, set a fallback, and notify listeners when the back button is pressed.

classes.name: AndroidBackHandler
classes.description: A class that manages a set of listeners for Android back button events, allowing adding, removing, and notifying these listeners, with support for a fallback listener.

methods.name: setFallbackListener
methods.description: Sets a fallback listener to be invoked if no other listener handles the back button event.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for back button events and returns a function to remove this listener.

methods.name: notifyEvent
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a back button event, invoking the fallback if none handle the event.
